description: The issuers the hub's control plane trusts, each for the credential types it may issue (#710, ADR-064). docker-compose.jad.yml sets edc.iam.trustedissuer.<alias>.id and .supportedtypes from this, and on Azure the control plane carries the same keys in JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS, recorded in scripts/azure/migrate-edc-to-v018.sh (retired, kept as that record, #927), where the issuer's DID names its Container App (azureDid); scripts/run-ehds-identity-checks.sh (TRUST-6.1) fails when the running control plane differs, and /compliance shows this list.

issuers.name: Health Dataspace issuer
issuers.role: The hub's own IssuerService: membership of the hub's data space and its EHDS credentials.

issuers.name: Simpl test data space, Governance Authority (fictional)
issuers.role: A Simpl data space's Governance Authority: membership of its data space, accepted as membership of the hub's (ADR-064, decision 2). Institut de Recherche Santé holds its membership from it.

issuers.name: Insurance and wellbeing data space, Governance Authority (fictional)
issuers.role: A second data space's Governance Authority (#934): membership of its data space, accepted as membership of the hub's for that type only. AlphaKasse DE holds its membership from it.
